title: tucano.logistics.shipment.out_for_delivery
description: The data of a ShipmentOutForDelivery: a courier left with the parcels for the address. The time is the CloudEvent time.

store.description: The slug of the store the fact belongs to (ADR 0031). Optional: a fact from before the stores has none.

attempt.description: The visit to the address this event is about, 1 to 3.
